scope: 200 distinct emoji-inspired motifs filtered against the 334 existing master icons
rankingMethod: Popularity-informed editorial selection; not a claim of exact current European rank order. Unicode frequency data is coarse and historical.
style:
Premium 3D app icon object in the style of Apple's iOS 3D emoji and Airbnb's 2025 category icons. Soft matte clay material with subtle subsurface softness and very fine micro texture, rounded bevelled edges, no outlines, no text, no logos, simple emoji-inspired facial features only for mood icons.
Camera: identical for every icon, three-quarter front view from slightly above (about 20 degrees), orthographic feel, no strong perspective distortion.
Light: one large soft key light from the upper left, gentle fill from the right, a very soft rim light, a small soft contact shadow directly under the object.
Palette: warm off-white #F7F4EE, sand #E9DCC6, dusty sage #A9BBA3, soft blush #F2C9C4, sky #C9D9E6, deep teal #075056 as the only strong accent. Never more than three colors per object.
Canvas: 1024 x 1024 px, fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). The object sits centered inside a 640 x 640 px safe area, with empty space around it.
One object only, simple and readable at 32 px, calm and friendly, calm and friendly, not hyperactive; simple clay features, no text.
